headline: India to lower tariffs on vast array of US industrial, agricultural goods to zero per cent: USTR - OrissaPOST
summary: India will lower tariffs on a 'vast array' of American industrial and agricultural goods, including fruits and vegetables, to zero under a trade deal announced by President Trump, USTR Jamieson Greer said.
why: Tariff changes under a bilateral deal alter export opportunities for US farm and industrial producers and import costs for Indian buyers.
